name: poisson-validation
title: Poisson validation: MMS correctness
question:
Does the dolfinx-backed `PoissonSolverStep` reproduce the exact solution of
a manufactured steady Poisson problem to numerical precision?
hypothesis:
Degree-2 Lagrange elements exactly represent the quadratic manufactured
solution used here (Galerkin orthogonality), so the L2 error against the
analytic solution should sit at floating-point round-off, not merely
"small".
objective:
Solve the steady Poisson equation -div(grad(u)) = f on the unit square with
a manufactured (known-exact) quadratic solution, and verify the FEM
solution matches the exact solution to within numerical tolerance. This is
the correctness baseline every other study in the investigation builds on.
description:
Wraps a single `PoissonSolverStep` (Task 2) in the `poisson_baseline`
composite generator. The Step is stateless -- given only mesh resolution +
polynomial degree, it builds the mesh, solves -Laplacian(u) = -6 subject to
the manufactured solution's Dirichlet boundary values, and reports both the
nodal solution and its L2 error against the exact solution
u = 1 + x^2 + 2*y^2.

expected_behavior.name: l2-error-within-tolerance
expected_behavior.en: The FEM solution's L2 error against the manufactured exact solution is below 1e-10.
expected_behavior.rationale: Degree-2 Lagrange elements exactly represent the quadratic manufactured solution (Galerkin orthogonality), so l2_error should sit at floating-point round-off (~1e-13), confirming the dolfinx bridge reproduces the analytic MMS result rather than merely approximating it.

behavior_tests.name: l2-error-within-tolerance
behavior_tests.description:
The L2 norm of (numeric solution - exact manufactured solution) must be
within numerical tolerance of zero.

provenance.note: A quadratic manufactured solution lies exactly in the degree-2 Lagrange trial space, so the discretization error is zero up to solver/quadrature round-off; 1e-10 is a generous ceiling above that floor (observed ~2.8e-13).

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:
The MMS L2 error is within tolerance (l2-error-within-tolerance passes),
confirming the dolfinx bridge is numerically correct before building
the convergence sweep and the time-stepped diffusion studies on top of
it.

embed_visualizations.name: solution-heatmap
embed_visualizations.description: Interactive Plotly heatmap of the FEM solution vs the manufactured exact solution.
